item.title: Atlagic-Bosnian-Pasha-Appointment-1687
item.description: Atlagić’s Appointment as Bosnian Pasha (early 1687) In early 1687 Mehmed Atlagić was exempted from a 50,000-real tribute owed to the Grand Vizier in exchange for a promise to return Morlach refugees to the sultan and lead the campaign against Venice as Bosnian pasha (docs 163, 170, Desnica-1951-Kota...

item.title: Atlagic-Poison-Attempt-1687
item.description: Senate-Approved Attempt to Poison Atlagić (22 January 1687) On 22 January 1687 the Inquisitori di Stato sent Girolamo Cornaro poison and instructions for an attempt on the life of Mehmed Atlagić, freshly appointed Bosnian pasha (docs 165, 167, Desnica-1951-Kotarski-Uskoci-II).

item.title: Battle-of-Ribnik-1648
item.description: Battle of Ribnik (16–17 July 1648) Catastrophic defeat of the Kotarski uskoci led by don Stjepan Sorić and harambaše Petar Smiljanić and Janko Mitrović, in their attempt to take the Lika fortress of Ribnik during the early phase of the Candian War.

item.title: Bjelaj-Vakuf-Raid-1685
item.description: Bjelaj and Vakuf Raid (early September 1685) Stojan Janković with Tartaglia, Geliseo and Razzetini destroyed the Bjelaj fortress and its Vakuf in early September 1685 and brought back about 500 Orthodox musketeers from Srb to Venetian territory (docs 97, 98, Desnica-1951-Kotarski-Uskoci-II).

item.title: Bortulacic-Murder-Vrana-1692
item.description: Murder of Šimun Bortulačić at Vrana (16 January 1692) Šimun (Simon) Bortulačić — kavalier, one of the four 1684 capi de Morlacchi, governor of Vrana — killed at Vrana on 16 January 1692 by men from Biograd and Pakostane; aged ~31; covered with stones (Desnica II, chunk 3 attestations).

item.title: Bosnian-Pasha-April-1688-Raid
item.description: Bosnian Pasha’s April 1688 Raid on Kotari About 5,000 Bosnian cavalry under Atlagić crossed via Livno and Knin to Popovići in April 1688 and plundered the Kotari plain from Nadin to Novigrad (docs 198, 200, Desnica-1951-Kotarski-Uskoci-II).

item.title: Bosnian-Pasha-Kotari-Raid-1686
item.description: Bosnian Pasha’s Raid on Kotari (12–19 November 1686) About 16,000 Turks under five pashas, supported by 6-pounder cannon, descended from Knin onto the Kotari plain between 12 and 19 November 1686 (docs 149–157, Desnica-1951-Kotarski-Uskoci-II).

item.title: Bribir-Ambush-1668
item.description: Zaseda na bribirskom potoku (9 December 1668) Set-piece ambush by 200 horse + 200 foot of Kotarci (under Stojan Janković, Smoljan Smiljanić and Giovanni Battista Soppe Fortezza) of a 120-strong elite Knin Turkish raiding party led by Ibraim aga Kovačević.
